description: Capability for the SOMS single-window shell. The window (label "main") hosts the merged SPA at the LOCAL origin tauri://localhost (the bundled frontendDist; OTA bundle updates swap the served dir via Context::set_assets). It gets core IPC, desktop notifications, and all app-defined commands (origin/token + shell init_* + desktop SSE supervisor sse_*) via the app-commands "default" aggregate. The webview reaches the runtime-configured backend through the LOCAL `api://localhost` URI-scheme proxy (src/lib.rs `proxy_api`), which forwards to ${api_origin} with the Bearer — so the webview never crosses origins (no CORS, no tauri-plugin-http). The SSE downlink on desktop is owned by the `sse_*` commands (a URI-scheme responder can't stream a long-lived body).
